learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected About half as far for Indonesia versus contiguous US and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Move Indonesia onto the US overlaid orange islands on blue states. Measure both showed Indonesia 5320 km and US 4650 km; reveal unlocked. Put Indonesia back returned real position while both measurements remained.
observations.reveal: Further than US, about15% longer on this lesson's outlines using same farthest-point method. Smaller land area can span sea gaps; moving around globe preserves internal distances.
observations.visual: Inline initial and measured-overlay screenshots inspected. Orange Indonesia stretches beyond blue US, solid orange and dashed white rulers labelled with distances. Ruler caption defines farthest outline points over globe. Trust6/6 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
